verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no native connector to QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite or any general ledger/ERP. Finance data can only reach the GL through extra tooling: revenue-recognition source data is stored at daily granularity and exportable to a data warehouse, and webhooks fire when invoices finalize. The only native invoice syncs documented are to Stripe and the cloud marketplaces, not to accounting systems. Missing for 10: native GL/ERP sync to QuickBooks, Xero or NetSuite; automated posting of invoices, payments and recognition journal entries; any independent or hands-on corroboration.
